claim_boundary: P3-02 proves that OpenRecomp can safely and deterministically ingest the audited CoreMark MIPS32 ELF and construct its guest section/data image. It does not prove that all CoreMark instructions are supported, that CoreMark can yet be translated or run, or any arbitrary ELF/MIPS32/console compatibility.
